title: Lenskart Solutions among 4 stocks to hit 52-week highs & surge up to 25% in a month - Fresh Highs | The Economic Times
text:
On Wednesday, the benchmark Sensex fell 325 points to close at 76,909. Despite the broader market weakness, four stocks from the BSE 200 Index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their strongest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high is generally considered a positive technical indicator, reflecting strong investor interest, improving market sentiment, and the potential for further upward momentum.

New 52-week high: Rs 3051| CMP: Rs 3034.05. In the last one month stock has gained about 24%.

New 52-week high: Rs 645.1| CMP: Rs 640. In the last one month stock has gained about 19%.

New 52-week high: Rs 49129.95| CMP: Rs 48360. In the last one month stock has gained about 18%.

New 52-week high: Rs 173.25| CMP: Rs 170.35. In the last one month stock has gained about 18%.
